target.statement: MSS-PAE achieves the best average AUROC of 0.889 across 32 OD datasets (41% relative improvement over best baseline DIP)

compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement PAE (dual-output AE with NLL/WNLL loss), MSS scoring, and the full 32-dataset benchmark protocol including 13 baselines, with per-dataset hyperparameter tuning of alpha and k.
